title: module.yml
description: The metadata of one kit module: modules/<name>/module.yml. docs/modules.md says what each key means. The gate validates every module.yml against this file, and kit install refuses a module whose keys it does not know.

description.description: One line, shown by kit module list.

default.description: true for a module active unless removed; kit install with no names activates every default module.

items.description: The name of another module in the release, activated with this one.

^[a-z_]+$.description: The default value of a template key, written @key@ in the module's templates.
